note: Real public data read once from Zetaris: Octopus Agile price (inc VAT), NESO carbon intensity and generation mix (London), Open-Meteo hourly temperature, Octopus published Agile standing charge. No meter data (meter kWh in this project are SAMPLE data).

queries.sql:
SELECT r.slot_start AS ts, r.p_kwh_inc_vat AS p, c.forecast_gco2_kwh AS intensity, c.wind_pct, c.gas_pct, c.imports_pct
FROM kilowhy.agile_rates r LEFT JOIN kilowhy.ci_london c ON r.slot_start = c.slot_start
WHERE r.slot_start >= timestamp '2026-08-27 00:00:00' AND r.slot_start < timestamp '2026-10-22 00:00:00' ORDER BY r.slot_start
SELECT ts, temp_c FROM kilowhy.temp_hourly WHERE ts >= timestamp '2026-08-27 00:00:00' AND ts < timestamp '2026-10-22 00:00:00' ORDER BY ts
SELECT CAST(valid_from AS STRING) AS valid_from, p_day_exc_vat, p_day_inc_vat FROM kilowhy.agile_standing ORDER BY valid_from
